nameChecks.en: Twisted and Disjointed Memory and Recollection

nameChecks.ja: 小指の親方 - 塩見ヨル
幾重もの時間から斬り込む残像

nameChecks.en: Rend Space - String Connection [空間斬-緣]

gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 2 enemy, skill, passive, and status records. Deathedge uses enemy skill 132208 rather than the Liferender status. Shin uses the enemy status rather than the Identity variant. Unconfirmed skill Power, the Shield ending condition, Turn 11 survival, and max-HP-based damage are preserved.

lead.text: You do not need to reduce HP to 0. Deplete the Disjunction Shield or survive through the end of Turn 11 to progress. Have fast Sinners beat Silent Regard and Phantom Step first to make later major attacks safer.

statNote.text: The normal 9-33 battle. Deploy 7 Sinners with 5 backups; Ryōshū is required. Restore the team size after the preceding four-Sinner battle. The enemy starts at Lv. 77 with 45 SP and 1,600 Disjunction, with no fixed level reduction. Dealing damage that would reduce the Shield to 0, or reaching the end of Turn 11, triggers the event. Treat this separately from the battles at 9-41 and 9-48.

skillNote.text: Phantom Step and Silent Regard have inconsistent Power listings, so their Base Power and displayed Power are marked unconfirmed. Check the actual clash prediction. Rend Space - String Connection is shown with 20 Base Power and +6 Coin Power; its +5 Final Power at 10 or more SP is listed separately in the effects.

priorities.0.text: Restore the team to 7 deployed Sinners and 5 backups. Keep Sinners other than Ryōshū alive too.

priorities.1.text: Weaken the enemy through Silent Regard and reduce Bladetrail through Phantom Step before taking the major attacks.

priorities.2.text: Deplete 1,600 Disjunction or survive 11 turns. There is no need to reduce the enemy's HP to 0.

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: The enemy starts at Lv. 77 with 45 SP. Have a fast Sinner beat Silent Regard first to inflict Attack Power Down, then handle the remaining skills. Use leveling, healing, and the Sapling of Light as needed.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Allies die even after winning against a major attack

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Unbreakable Coins and max-HP-based damage from Bladetrail remain. Before the major attack, win against Phantom Step to halve Bladetrail and heal in advance. The 80% damage reduction does not erase every source of damage.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The team still has only four Sinners from the previous battle

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: This battle returns to 7 deployed Sinners and 5 backups. Increase the deployment count and bring leveled backups. Ryōshū loses her protection if no other ally remains alive.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: A low-HP Sinner dies without even evading

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: Deathedge prevents Defense Skills from activating and prioritizes low-HP Sinners other than Ryōshū. Stop it with an attack, or heal everyone to at least 50% HP before it appears to remove the condition for the extra action.

units.0.speed.text: 3–5 / Range −2 from Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement / Major attacks: 20 and 30

units.0.stagger.text: 50% (959) / Losing Disjunction causes Stagger at the relevant stages

units.0.notes.0.text: Starts with 45 SP, 1 Shin (心) - Dihui Star, Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement, and 1,600 Disjunction.

units.0.notes.1.text: One attack slot consumes 2 points of Atk Weight. Do not count secondary targets as though this enemy used ordinary slot sizes.

units.0.notes.2.text: The battle ends when damage would reduce the Shield to 0, or at the end of Turn 11. The final damage that would break the Shield becomes 0.

phases.0.title.text: Bring seven Sinners and backups, Slash resistance, and healing

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Deploy 7 Sinners with 5 backups; Ryōshū is required. Expand the preceding four-Sinner team with additional leveled Sinners.

phases.0.steps.1.text: The enemy is Lv. 77 with 45 SP. Bring Slash resistance, HP and SP recovery, and strong clashers. If the level gap makes clashes unwinnable, consider MOROSITAS from the Sapling of Light.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally is alive, but this does not keep the other Sinners alive. Spend healing on them too.

phases.1.title.text: Have a fast Sinner beat Silent Regard first

phases.1.steps.0.text: Winning against Silent Regard gives the enemy 2 Attack Power Down and restores 5 SP to the Sinner who clashes with it. Assign a fast Sinner so the debuff lands before the later attacks.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Plan the remaining clashes with the weakened enemy in mind. A clash win by Ryōshū also lowers the enemy's SP by 5, letting her contribute both strong clashes and resource generation.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Winning against Swift Glimmer reduces its Atk Weight from 3 to 1. Prioritize clashing with it to protect secondary targets.

phases.2.title.text: Let Sinners with high Bladetrail halve their stacks

phases.2.steps.0.text: Every 10 Bladetrail [Afterimage] grants 1 Fragile next turn. Major attacks also convert it into max-HP-based damage, so win against Phantom Step to reduce it.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Assign fast Sinners with high Bladetrail. Once the total across all Sinners reaches 50, Dihui Star's Blade also strengthens the next major attack.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Deathedge is more likely to be added when a Sinner other than Ryōshū falls below 50% HP. Heal to remove the condition, or clash with the added skill using an attack. Defense alone cannot handle it.

phases.3.timing.text: Formless Cut and the four-turn major attack cycle

phases.3.title.text: Use strong clashes and advance healing to survive Unbreakable Coins

phases.3.steps.0.text: Formless Cut and Rend Space can be clashed with regardless of Speed. Winning reduces their damage by 80% and prevents their targets from being Staggered by the skill. Even a slow Sinner can intercept them with a strong skill.

phases.3.steps.1.text: At 50 or more Dihui Star's Blade, the attack changes to Rend Space - String Connection. At 10 or more SP, it gains another +5 Final Power. Do not choose the clasher based on Base Power alone.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Rend Space consumes all Bladetrail to deal additional max-HP-based damage. Reduce Bladetrail and restore HP beforehand. The turn ends after the attack, so do not leave healing until afterward.

phases.4.title.text: Break the Shield or survive through Turn 11

phases.4.steps.0.text: Use Wrath, Gloom, and Slash damage to deplete the 1,600 Disjunction Shield. Meeting the Shield-breaking condition triggers the event; you do not need to deplete the remaining 1,918 HP.

phases.4.steps.1.text: If damage is insufficient, prioritize healing and clash wins to reach the end of Turn 11. Skills deal half damage to targets that use Defense Skills, but Deathedge is an exception because it prevents Defense Skills from activating.

phases.4.steps.2.text: At the end of every fourth turn, the enemy gains Fragile and Damage Up. Your attacks become more effective, but incoming damage also rises. Manage remaining HP and healing resources.

skills.0.response.text: Gains Poise Count on use and Poise Potency on hit. Weaken the enemy by beating Silent Regard, then win the remaining clashes with the other Sinners.

skills.1.response.text: A regular three-Coin skill that gains Poise. Account for the level gap and the enemy's current SP as well as the listed Power.

skills.2.effects.6.text: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Bladetrail [Afterimage]

skills.2.response.text: An Unbreakable attack with 3 Atk Weight. Winning the clash reduces its Atk Weight by 2, making it single-target. Prioritize clashing with it, as an unopposed attack grants it 5 Poise.

skills.3.effects.1.text: This skill can be clashed with regardless of Speed. The user cannot be Staggered until the skill ends.

skills.3.effects.2.text: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; targets taking damage from this skill cannot be Staggered

skills.3.effects.7.text: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Bladetrail [Afterimage]

skills.3.response.text: An Indiscriminate attack that reuses its single Unbreakable Coin up to four times. Clash with it regardless of Speed to gain 80% damage reduction and protection from Stagger caused by the skill. Bladetrail and additional damage still require care.

skills.4.effects.0.text: This skill can be clashed with regardless of Speed. The user cannot be Staggered until the skill ends.

skills.4.effects.1.text: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; targets taking damage from this skill cannot be Staggered

skills.4.effects.5.text: [On Hit] Consume all Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target; deal HP damage equal to (amount consumed)% of each target's max HP

skills.4.response.text: An Unbreakable attack with 7 Atk Weight. Win with a strong skill regardless of Speed to gain 80% damage reduction. Heal beforehand to prepare for max-HP-based damage from consuming all Bladetrail and for the turn ending after the attack.

skills.5.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] Halve the target's Bladetrail [Afterimage] (rounded down)

skills.5.response.text: Winning halves Bladetrail on the Sinner who clashes with it. Have a fast Sinner with Bladetrail handle it before the major attack. Its Power is unconfirmed, so also check the actual clash prediction.

skills.6.effects.1.text: [Clash Lose] Heal the target for 5 SP

skills.6.response.text: Winning gives the enemy 2 Attack Power Down and restores 5 SP to the Sinner handling it. Win early with a fast Sinner to improve later clashes against regular and area attacks. Its Power is unconfirmed.

skills.7.effects.0.text: This skill prevents the target's Defense Skill from activating

skills.7.effects.1.text: Targets the unit with the lowest current HP percentage

skills.7.effects.3.text: Ⅰ [On Hit] Inflict 1 Bladetrail [Afterimage] for every 1% HP the target has lost

skills.7.effects.4.text: Ⅱ [On Hit] Consume all Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target; deal HP damage equal to (amount consumed)% of the target's max HP

skills.7.response.text: Targets low-HP Sinners other than Ryōshū and prevents Defense Skills from activating. Clash with an attack instead of relying on Evade. Lower HP means more Bladetrail, followed by max-HP-based damage on the next Coin.

skills.8.name.text: Rend Space - String Connection [空間斬-緣]

skills.8.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the user's SP is 10 or higher, generate 1 Mang. Final Power +5

skills.8.effects.1.text: Can be clashed regardless of Speed; cannot be Staggered until this skill is used

skills.8.effects.2.text: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; targets taking damage from this skill cannot be Staggered

skills.8.effects.3.text: [After Attack] If this skill generated Mang, lose 10 SP

skills.8.effects.7.text: [On Hit] Consume all Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target; deal HP damage equal to (amount consumed)% of the target's max HP

skills.8.effects.9.text: A technique that cuts space: Rend Space. Cutting space is a long-held ambition of swordsmen, who have reached that realm through various methods.

skills.8.response.text: At 50 or more Dihui Star's Blade, this becomes a stronger Rend Space. At 10 or more SP, it also gains +5 Final Power. Win the clash for 80% damage reduction, but remember that this does not erase max-HP-based damage from Bladetrail. The turn ends after the attack.

passives.0.effect.text:
At Turn Start, gain Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement.
At the start of the first turn of a pattern, gain (Afterimage Entanglement stage × 400) Disjunction.
(Once per Afterimage Entanglement stage)

Losing all Disjunction at Afterimage Entanglement stages 3 and 4 changes the pattern and Staggers the user throughout the next turn.

HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement caused by Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.

passives.0.condition.text: Battle start and loss of Disjunction

passives.0.response.text: Start by depleting the 1,600 Disjunction Shield. Alternatively, reduce Bladetrail and survive; the event also triggers at the end of Turn 11.

passives.1.effect.text:
Uses a powerful skill every 4 turns.
- If Dihui Star's Blade is 50 or higher, the skill is enhanced.
“...A loathsome blade, like a brand.”

passives.1.condition.text: Four-turn major attack cycle; Dihui Star's Blade at 50 or higher

passives.1.response.text: The total Bladetrail across all Sinners strengthens the major attack. Reduce it with Phantom Step and save healing and high-Power skills for the major attack.

passives.2.effect.text:
The user's skills deal 50% less final damage to targets that use Defense Skills.

At Turn End every 4 turns, gain 2 Fragile and 2 Damage Up for the rest of the encounter (stacks up to twice per encounter).

passives.2.condition.text: Use of Defense Skills; end of every fourth turn

passives.2.response.text: Final skill damage is halved against targets using Defense Skills. However, Deathedge prevents Defense Skills from activating, so do not rely on Defense for every attack.

passives.3.effect.text: At Turn End, if Panicked, set SP to 30

passives.3.response.text: SP returns to 30. Lowering SP does not disable the enemy for long.

passives.4.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.4.response.text: Instead of relying on replacing the Panic effect, win against weaker skills first.

passives.5.effect.text: On Coin hit, deal Slash damage equal to (that Coin's final damage ÷ 10). Trigger this once per Afterimage Entanglement stage. This damage cannot Stagger.

passives.5.response.text: Deals additional Slash damage once per Afterimage stage. Damage that cannot Stagger still reduces HP, so bring healing and resistance.

passives.6.effect.text:
At the end of an Attack Skill, deal Slash damage to each target equal to (number of Slash Coins that critically hit × 10). This damage cannot Stagger.

At the end of an Attack Skill, consume all Poise above 20 and inflict Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target equal to the amount consumed.

passives.6.response.text: Adds damage and Bladetrail after attacks. Do not leave Sinners at low HP; reduce Bladetrail through Phantom Step.

mechanics.0.name.text: Twisted and Disjointed Memory and Recollection

mechanics.0.effect.text: Ryōshū gains 1 skill slot. She deals and takes 20% more damage against the Pinky Nursefather; her clash wins lower his SP by 5. Damage that would Stagger her removes her Stagger Thresholds and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn (once per turn). Using a skill generates 1 resource of its affinity and 1 of a missing affinity (twice per turn). She cannot retreat.

mechanics.0.response.text: Spend the resources on healing and debuffs. Ryōshū also takes more damage, so do not rely solely on her conditional protection from death.

mechanics.1.effect.text: At battle start, grants a Shield equal to its value; the value decreases as the Shield is depleted. Starts at 1,600.

mechanics.1.response.text: Damage that would reduce the Shield to 0 meets this battle's ending condition. There is no need to reduce HP to 0.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 99. At Turn Start, every 10 grants 1 Fragile (max 5). Major attacks consume all of it to deal max-HP-based damage.

mechanics.2.response.text: Halve it by winning against Phantom Step, then heal before the major attack.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Speed range −2. On hit, inflicts 1 Poison, 2 Bleed, 1 Bind next turn, and 2 Burn.

mechanics.3.response.text: Check which skills still hit after a clash win and heal the damage caused by status effects.

mechanics.4.effect.text: The combined Bladetrail on all Sinners on the field. At 50 or higher, it strengthens the periodic major attack.

mechanics.4.response.text: Check everyone's Bladetrail when assigning Phantom Step, rather than watching only one Sinner.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Maximum 3. At Turn Start, gain 5 Poise Potency and 1 Poise Count per stack. Gain 1 Slash Damage Up for every 15% HP lost (max 5).

mechanics.5.response.text: Check predictions with the enemy's Poise and current status in mind. Its Power does not stay at its starting value throughout the battle.

warnings.0.text: Phantom Step and Silent Regard have unconfirmed Power. Their debuff and Bladetrail-halving effects remain useful, but the listed numbers alone cannot guarantee a clash win.

warnings.1.text: Additional damage that cannot Stagger still reduces HP. Unbreakable Coin damage reduction and max-HP-based Bladetrail damage are separate effects.

warnings.2.text: Deathedge prevents Defense Skills from activating. Simply assigning Evade to a low-HP Sinner is insufficient.

warnings.3.text: No actions occur after Rend Space. Complete healing and debuffing beforehand.

warnings.4.text: 9-33 allows progression through survival. Do not apply the ending conditions of the related or similarly named bosses at 9-41 and 9-48.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Lv. 60. Bring 7 deployed Sinners and 5 backups, Slash resistance, and healing resources. Assign fast Sinners to Silent Regard and Phantom Step.

preparation.1.text: Combine strong single-target clashes, Attack Power Down, and HP/SP recovery. Surviving through Turn 11 allows progression, so a short burst of damage is not the only approach.

roles.0.reason.text: Beat Silent Regard early to help the other Sinners win their clashes.

roles.1.reason.text: Halve Bladetrail through Phantom Step to reduce max-HP-based damage from the major attack.

roles.2.reason.text: Win with a strong skill regardless of Speed to gain 80% damage reduction.

roles.3.reason.text: Survive Unbreakable Coins and additional damage until the ending condition is met.
